scope.plan: DWG_DXF_OPEN_SOURCE_PARITY_PLAN.md P8 / BLOCK callback coverage; P6 shape field correctness
scope.operation: Retain and serialize named DXF SHAPE entities through the BLOCK adapter while refusing output that lacks the required DXF group-2 shape name or relies only on a DWG SHAPEFILE table handle.
behavior: The concrete BLOCK adapter captures DRW_Shape values, charges the style-name string and retained raw bytes, and dispatches the runtime SHAPE type to dxfRW::writeShape.
The low-level SHAPE serializer refuses an empty group-2 name and does not publish an incomplete SHAPE record.
The DXF adapter refuses a DWG-origin SHAPE with a nonzero SHAPEFILE handle because the current DWG reader resolves the STYLE row name, not the actual SHX glyph name required by DXF group 2.
Generated AC1027 ASCII/Binary named-BLOCK controls verify named-shape callback readback, fields, empty-name refusal with destination preservation, and corrected retry through the same adapter.

normativeReference.title: Autodesk SHAPE (DXF)
normativeReference.relevantField: Group code 2 is the shape name.

limitations: No SHX-backed mapping from a DWG glyph index to the DXF SHX shape name is implemented; DWG-origin SHAPE output is intentionally refused when the source handle is present.
The generated vectors establish codec and adapter transport only, not external producer behavior or native glyph rendering.
This does not qualify complete document conversion, LibreCAD/LibreCAD_3, FreeCAD, platform, ABI, or package support.
